content.comment_body: Hello, I have developed a CFC code on [company_name] [product_name] where I read and write a single analog input (real value) using a converter. The delay between the input and output signals is around 160 µs. My question is whether all analog inputs are scanned even if they are not selected, since I'd like to create a program that manages 8 analog inputs using a converter with a conversion time of 40 µs per channel. Is this achievable?
Closed: This thread was duplicated. The other discussion can be found here: [document].
